title: Succubus Surprise (ORIGINAL)
description: You're a man who’s obsessed with the idea of having an encounter with a succubus. Asking your friend to help you with a summoning ritual, to no avail. I console you by detailing what an actual succubus encounter might be like, which also drops you into a horny trance. Surprise! I'm actually a succubus myself! And I'm going to use a combination of succubus magic and seduction to fully convert you into my mind fucked toy and drain you dry.
